prompt_md: You fold a 30 cm by 40 cm sheet of paper so that two opposite corners meet exactly. How long is the fold line, in cm?
prompt_short: Fold a 30 × 40 cm sheet so opposite corners meet. Crease length?
hint_md: The crease is the perpendicular bisector of the diagonal.
explain_intuition_md: The crease isn't the diagonal: it crosses it at right angles through the centre. Its slope is steep, so it hits the long edges before reaching the corners.
